content: Standard AWS scaling policy: CPU > 80% for 5min → scale out 20%. Memory > 75% → prioritize memory-optimized instances. Never exceed 90% disk utilization.
Historical incident report: Jan 2024 - request rate 2x spike caused 500ms response time degradation. Resolution: Added 3 EC2 instances, CloudWatch alarms for CPU>70%.
Capacity best practices: Forecast 20% buffer above peak. Auto-scaling policy: Scale in when CPU < 40% for 15min. Disk: Use EBS gp3, provisioned IOPS for high throughput.
Post-mortem: Memory leak in Node.js app caused OOM kills at 85% utilization. Action: Deploy to ECS Fargate with 16GB memory, health checks.
Network scaling guideline: NetworkIn > 100Mbps + CPU>70% → consider larger instance types (m5.large → m5.xlarge). Use ELB target groups.
